fixes.title: WebPage JSON-LD template
fixes.body:
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "WebPage",
  "name": "OpenAEO Fixture Publisher Guide",
  "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4173/",
  "description": "A local fixture page used to validate OpenAEO audits for publisher attribution and AI readiness."
}
fixes.rationale: WebPage markup provides a general-purpose schema baseline for any page that does not fit a narrower type.

fixes.title: Organization JSON-LD template
fixes.rationale: Organization markup reinforces the publisher identity behind the source material.

fixes.title: FAQPage JSON-LD template
fixes.rationale: FAQ markup turns answer blocks into explicit question-and-answer structure for crawlers.

fixes.title: Article JSON-LD template
fixes.rationale: Article markup helps answer engines recognize authorship, canonical URLs, and freshness signals.

fixes.title: Citation block pattern
fixes.body:
### Sources

- [Primary source title](https://example.com/source) - why it supports this claim.
- [Publisher evidence page](/research/example) - first-party context and methodology.
fixes.rationale: Clear sources make generated answers more verifiable and more likely to credit the publisher.

recommendations: Keep /llms.txt current as important pages change.
Prefer canonical, dated, author-attributed pages over thin landing pages.
